title: Self-Awareness
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child states good things about himself or herself as God's creation (Psalm 139:13) and lists chores done at home.

floor.question: Are any two people exactly the same?

steps: Say one thing you like about yourself.
contexts: a new baby in the family

board.do: Wait for the child to say God.
Write one good thing each child says.

listen_for: Nothing, I am not the best
misconceptions.ask: Name one thing you like about yourself.
misconceptions.repair: Read Psalm 139:13-14. Let each child say one good thing about a classmate, then about himself.

listen_for: No, only how I look counts
misconceptions.ask: Is being kind something to like about yourself?
misconceptions.repair: List good things we cannot see: kind, brave, helpful.

misconceptions.ask: Which is a chore: sweeping or watching TV?
misconceptions.repair: A chore is a job that helps at home. Sort cards into chores and play.

misconceptions.ask: Does liking yourself mean you are better than others?
misconceptions.repair: Say: God made each person special; liking yourself and others go together.

checks.question: Name a chore you do at home.
Who knit you together, says Psalm 139:13?
